notes.title: Update Notes For Aug 19
notes.content: September is sneaking up on us! Next month we'll be tracking creativity with the September 2025 Journal. It's loaded with daily features to keep you organized, and you'll also see a funky picture at the end of the week, but only if you keep up your daily creativity! Find it in the Writeway store today to start getting ready for an imaginative month. In this update, we're making some internal improvements to prepare for some exciting new journals releasing this fall.

notes.title: Update Notes For Aug 12
notes.content:
Have you heard the Perseids are peaking? If you're up late, it's an amazing time to journal under the skies.  Just don't forget to keep your eyes peeled for meteors! In this update we're adding Book Info: a simple text area with big possibilities. Inside any journal, click the "Book Details" icon at the top left to start editing. Here you'll find a convenient spot for notes, links to your most important pages, or anything else you want to remember.
P.S. we're working hard on a big surprise. Check back soon for a delightful new way to view your pages.

notes.title: Update Notes Jul 25
notes.content: Can you believe August is just around the corner? Even if your summer is speeding by, you can always take a moment to slow down with Writeway. To get started, all you need is the August 2025 journal from our store (and maybe a water bottle - we're tracking hydration this month). This updates improved performance for journals with many pages.

tags.feature: This updates improved performance for journals with many pages.

notes.title: Update Notes For Jul 11
notes.content: Have you checked out the July 2025 journal yet? It's your summer best friend: track simple tasks and habits, get in a routine of fueling your body with healthy foods, and log your best (or worst) moments. This update adds two new ways to find a certain page while you're working on a journal. First, Book Details has new Table of Contents and Calendar views - find them using the book icon in the top-left. Second, Thumbnail View now lets you click or tap a page to jump straight to a certain spot in our journal - try out Thumbnail View by choosing the four small squares icon.

notes.title: Update Notes For Jun 16
notes.content: Have you been soaking up the sun? Whether you are already or you've got some things to get done first, the June 2025 Journal is the perfect spot for big plans and big memories this month. We're prepping for summer with a new app icon in this update, hope it makes you smile :)

notes.title: Update Notes For May 7
notes.content:
More journals, more you
Free users can now create up to 5 new journals.
Pages like paper
Instead of one long scroll, journals now have paper-like pages. This gives you more control and helps you stay organized. Pick from different page templates when adding new pages.
A more focused space
We’ve removed the background and sound feature known as “Vibe.” If you’re looking for ambiance while you journal, we recommend and love wellspace.app.
Streaks are easier to keep
Streaks are now under Profile > Rewards where you’ll be able to claim a daily reward just for checking in.
The longer your streak, the bigger the rewards—stay consistent and stack up the perks!

notes.title: Update Notes For August 19
notes.content: It's back-to-school season! Why not set yourself up for success by setting goals and building habits? Check out Discover > Writing Meditations > Memories in the Writeway app to find the "Good Habits" and "Goal Setting" books. This update improves the display of pricing info for international users when purchasing credits or a subscription.

notes.title: Update Notes for july 31
notes.content: Friendships can be some of the most valuable treasures in our lives. At this seasonal midpoint, it's a great time to reflect on the experiences you've shared with a close friend. Visit Discover > Writing Meditations > Memories in the Writeway app to find "Friendship Memories". This update addresses an issue in which the soft keyboard did not reopen as expected after using certain commands.

notes.title: Update Notes for July 19
notes.content: Summer can be one of the busiest times of the year! Our Daily Reflections journal helps you make the most of each day by intentionally setting a focal theme each morning, then reflecting on the day each evening. Find it in the Discover > Daily Journals section of the Writeway app. This update addresses some UI glitches, including some buttons being cut off on small screens or not updating to match your content as you edit.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jun 18
notes.content: Solstice is almost here - if you live north of the Equator, June 20th will be the longest day of the year! We're using the extra daylight hours to make some fresh fixes for the Writeway app, and we hope you'll spend some of them journaling about your summer exploits. For our friends south of the equator, check out a new Writing Meditation for a quick way to get your daily writing streak on the year's shortest day.

notes.title: Update Notes May 30
notes.content: June is here and we're kicking it off with some fixes. If you're looking for something new, try embracing the freedom to change your mind this month: we've added a "Back to Editing" option that you can use while reviewing your Writing Meditation cards.

tags.feature: we've added a "Back to Editing" option that you can use while reviewing your Writing Meditation cards.

notes.title: Update Notes May 16
notes.content: Looking to try out more journal options? With this release we're adding some free bonus credits for our early adopters, meaning you can explore more! Grab the update then check your credit balance in the Explore page for a surprise gift.

tags.feature: With this release we're adding some free bonus credits for our early adopters, meaning you can explore more!

notes.title: Update Notes for May 3
notes.content: A new way to collect journals is here! Our guided journals and writing meditations can now be unlocked using credits. This update also packs several features to improve your writing experience: Meditation Practice allow you to earn credits by completing writing meditations several days in a week and Library offers a new, streamlined way to access all the books on your shelf. Finally, enjoy creating unlimited Notebooks and customizing the title/cover of each one - available now with Premium.
